composition_variation: Create a retro Japanese cafe illustration of Shinnosuke Nohara perched safely on a low wooden stool beside a tiny round table. A tall melon soda with vanilla ice cream sits on the table. He is fully dressed in his red shirt and yellow shorts, wearing an amused proud expression with recognizable rounded cheeks and broad eyebrows. Keep the furniture narrow and centered, with mint-green wall tiles, amber afternoon light, cream upholstery, and a mostly blank softly illuminated upper wall. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved in Codex local artifact directory anime-wallpapers-100/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized, not generated natively at final dimensions.
